Faculty group: RC 2.01, the agreement applies to all professors in the certified unit (RC 1.03: full- and half-time teaching staff of the professoriate, excluding deans, directors, clinical geographic-full-time physicians, visiting professors). U8 paths: AS 6.06, 6.15 and 6.20 pay 90% of regular salary for the whole maternity (25 weeks), adoption (5 weeks) or paternity (5 weeks) leave to a professor excluded from or ineligible for QPIP; the member described is QPIP-eligible, so these are recorded here, not as components. No equivalent is stated for the parental-leave supplement.
AS 6.05: during the first two weeks of the maternity leave the University advances 90% of regular salary, to be set against the supplement; recorded in c2 (not a separate stage).

Birth parent chain: special pregnancy leave where certified (c5, no length; LNT s. 81.5.1 c7 alongside; salary insurance c6 within) -> maternity leave 25 weeks (c1; LNT maternity 18 c4, QPIP maternity 18 c3 and the 90% supplement c2 inside; LNT 5 days c19 alongside) -> parental leave up to 2 years (c15; 90% supplement c16 in its first 10 weeks; LNT parental 52 c18 from week 18, alongside) ; QPIP maternity 18 -> QPIP parental 32 (c17); relief of one course per year on return from maternity leave (c25, course units).

Non-birth parent chain: paid week (c11; LNT 5 days c19 alongside) -> paternity leave 5 weeks = LNT s. 81.2 (c12; QPIP paternity 5 c14 and 90% supplement c13 inside) -> parental leave up to 2 years (c15; supplement c16 first 10 weeks; LNT parental 52 c18 alongside) ; QPIP paternity 5 -> QPIP parental 32 (c17). The one-course relief c26 is an alternative open only to a parent who did not take the paternity leave and paid parental leave (in_lieu_of c13, c16).

Sequence choice c12 consecutive_after c11: AS 6.16 b) grants the paternity leave 'en plus du congé visé par le paragraphe a)'; the paid week may fall in the month before the birth and the paternity leave may start in the week of birth, so the text lets the leave start when the paid week ends (longest-leave convention). c22 follows c21 on the same wording.

Paternity leave (AS 6.16 b) has the same length and window as LNT s. 81.2, so it is coded as the statute (schema, statute_source: an agreement article restating a statutory leave without adding length).
